title: Why So Many More Kids Are Being Diagnosed With ADHD
hook: Your kid's odds of being diagnosed with ADHD just hit 11.4 percent.
closing: More labels. Still not enough help.
question: Were you diagnosed as a kid? Tell me.

segments.say: ADHD diagnoses among US kids have climbed to 11.4 percent, nearly half again what they were two decades ago.
Boys are diagnosed with ADHD at nearly double the rate of girls, around 15 percent.
Only 53.6 percent of diagnosed kids are actually taking medication for it.
